Jesus will descend as a just judge, break the cross, kill swine and abolish jizya; wealth will go unaccepted, and he will decline the Muslims' invitation to lead their prayer.
In a vision near the Ka'bah the Prophet saw Jesus son of Mary circling it, water dripping from his head, and behind him the Dajjal, blind in the right eye.
Asleep, the Prophet saw himself circling the Ka'bah and saw the son of Mary, water flowing from his head, and then the Dajjal, bulky, red and blind in one eye.
The Prophet swore that the son of Mary will pronounce Talbiya for Hajj, Umrah or both in the valley of Rauha.
The Prophet said he is the closest of mankind to Jesus son of Mary, with no prophet between them, and that prophets are brothers of different mothers with one religion.
Jesus saw a man stealing, and when the man swore by Allah that he had not, Jesus said he believed in Allah and that his own self had deceived him.
